newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finmin seeks more ASEAN monetary cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Thai finmin seeks more ASEAN monetary cooperation.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Tuesday that Southeast Asian countries should increase monetary cooperation to create more stability in volatile regional financial markets.
"Under the globalisation era, we need to have monetary cooperation. ASEAN countries should increase their monetary cooperation in the long-term," Thanong told reporters.
ASEAN groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
